mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dodo_restock_notice (id, subscription_id, generation, kind, user_id, store_id, shop_id, goods_id, title, content, delivery_state, request_id, target_client_id, attempts, version, next_attempt_at, expires_at, created_at, updated_at, read_at, clicked_at, last_error) VALUES (#{id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{subscriptionId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{generation,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{kind,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{storeId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{shopId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{goodsId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{title,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{content,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deliveryState,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{requestId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{targetClientId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{attempts,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{version,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{nextAttemptAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{expiresAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{createdAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updatedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{readAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{clickedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{lastError,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.update: UPDATE dodo_restock_notice SET delivery_state = 'CANCELLED', version = version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE subscription_id = #{subscriptionId} AND delivery_state IN ('PENDING', 'REJECTED')
mapper.select: SELECT id,subscription_id,generation,goods_id,shop_id,kind,delivery_state,attempts,version,request_id,last_error,created_at,read_at,clicked_at FROM dodo_restock_notice WHERE store_id = #{storeId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
